summary: Pin sits in dense garden; nearest real stop is the busy visitor car park.
reasons: Pin in dense planting, no track

best_section.where: Asphalt visitor car park beside the Planetarium, about 64 m north-east of the pin

drivers.seclusion: No homes nearby; car park backs onto gardens, but it is the main visitor hub with a visitor centre and cafe.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin itself is under tree canopy with no track or tyre marks; the sealed car park has an unsigned-gate-free road in and plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Daytime tourist traffic; quiet after hours.
drivers.convention: Public gardens car park, no sign of overnight stays; closing hours unknown.

flags: Slope data is sampled at the pin (mean 8.8%), not the car park
Pin is off: in dense garden planting
Mapped gates 58 m and 189 m away have ways round
sun_shade: Car park is open to sun all day with some trees on its edges.
cannot_judge: Car park closing hours or overnight rules
